thread:
nina (arch): heads-up: I'm planning a multi-quarter paydown called 'slice-instrumentation-first' — goal is to reduce cross-cutting tech debt by (1) standardizing service-level telemetry and (2) consolidating thin cross-service infra bits into owned slices. sketch below, want early feedback before RFC.

omar (eng): curious about scope. are we moving code or just standardizing charts/metrics?

nina (arch): both. phase 1 = metrics & logs standardization (common labels, error taxonomy). phase 2 = extract thin infra adapters (auth proxies, enrichers, formatters) into per-domain slices. each slice gets an owner and a migration plan. emphasis on observable-first cut so we can measure regressions.

li (infra): must add a packing/capacity note. moving adapters can change instance footprints. propose a micro-capacity experiment before each slice migration.

zara (sre): agreed. also need explicit revert thresholds for SLOs and an automated smoke harness. I'll own the smoke harness runs if we schedule windows.

ci-bot: CI pipeline: test-plan template created at repo infra/paydown/test-plans/slice-template.md

omar (eng): incremental approach only. suggest these guardrails: (a) one adapter extracted per 6-week slice, (b) feature flag with progressive ramp, (c) prefill caches and warm pools before traffic shift.

nina (arch): anchoring to that. propose slice cadence: 6w design + 2w migration + 1w extended canary. owners: service team owns design, migration lead coordinates, ops owns canary.

li (infra): suggest instrumenting a canary metric set: [request.count, request.latency_p95, request.errors, adapter.cache_miss_rate]. also add cost delta tracking for tokenized workloads.

zara (sre): will add a runbook template: pre-metrics snapshot, smoke traffic script, rollback steps, post-mortem checklist. recommend auto-revert if latency_p95 > 2x baseline or error rate > 0.3%.

nina (arch): thanks. I'll draft RFC with: background, slice list (auth, enrich, format, validation), owner matrix, instrumentation spec, rollout policy, and runbooks. aiming to open RFC PR next Tues. please drop any hard constraints here.

omar (eng): volunteer to lead the enrich slice. preferences: keep model-backed enrich separate pool until we verify error behavior.

li (infra): i'll run capacity experiments for enrich. ping when RFC lands.

zara (sre): tag me on RFC early so I can validate thresholds. :+1:

nina (arch): great. if no objections i'll publish RFC draft Tuesday and add the migration calendar. thanks all for quick takes.
